payload.title: Phase A 6/8: browser checks at 375, 820, 1440 and 2560 px: whole rows, no repeats, scroll reaches every item
payload.description:
Phase A, step 6. Browser scenarios at 375, 820, 1440 and 2560 px (phone, tablet, laptop, wide; 2560 has 6 columns, 1440 has 3), drawn with Playwright like the existing measure tools.

Files:
1. tools/measure_reference_lists.cjs (new, same shape as tools/measure_section_page.cjs): `node tools/measure_reference_lists.cjs <origin> <route> <width> [--to-end]`. Prints JSON: `columns` (body --mom-cols or 3), `overflowX` (documentElement.scrollWidth > innerWidth), `leadRows` (cards per visual row in `.mom-refs-lead`, grouping by top within 40px as measure_section_page does), `blockRows` ({section aria-label: cards per visual row}), `streamColumns` (grid-template-columns count of the stream grid), `streamFirstPageCount`, `streamFirstPageRows`, `headingsInLeadOrStream` (count of h1-h6 inside `.mom-refs-lead, .mom-refs-stream`), `siteCardTouches` (any card box intersecting `.mom-page-card .mom-sticker`), and with `--to-end`: scroll to the bottom repeatedly, press the Load more button when the status reads "Press Load more to see more.", stop when `[data-reference-more]` is hidden or after 90 s; then `uniqueAddresses` (card links in lead + stream), `duplicates`, `status` (the live region's text).
2. features/reference-lists.feature and features/section-lists.feature get @browser Scenario Outlines with Examples widths 375, 820, 1440, 2560 (steps in features/steps/reference_list_steps.py; skip when Node or Playwright is missing; serve the projected case directory with the same static server helper the forum and section page browser steps use):
   - case "some", /videos/ and /findings/: every visual row of the lead and of every block is full (each row's count equals the row's own grid columns: 1 at 375; 2 or the spanning third at 820; the row's data-count at 1440 and 2560); the stream's first page fills whole rows (60 cards over its columns); no horizontal scroll; no heading inside the lead or the stream; the site title card touches no card.
   - case "none", /videos/ with --to-end: every one of the 200 videos is shown exactly once (4 in the lead + the rest in the stream) and the status says "All 196 are shown." (the script counts the stream grid only; the 4 lifted lead cards are not in it).
   - case "all", /security/videos/ with --to-end: all 70 shown once.
   - case "all", /videos/: no lead, no stream, no Load more, first block feature layout, rows full.
   - case "empty", /videos/: the empty sentence is visible and the site title card does not cover it.
3. Document the command in the feature narrative: `PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE=<path to playwright> behave features/reference-lists.feature features/section-lists.feature --tags=@browser`.

Acceptance: all browser scenarios pass locally with Playwright; attach the JSON of one run per width to the PR description.
